interface.name: get_product
interface.title: Get Product Details
interface.description: Returns the full details of ONE product by its id -- description, price, stock, storefront links, categories, and its option and variant breakdown.
whenToUse: The merchant named one specific product and wants everything about it, e.g. 'tell me about the leather wallet' or 'show me product 1672932878'.

The merchant asks about a product's variants or options, e.g. 'which sizes of the T-Shirt are left?' -- read the skus array for per-variant stock and price, and options for the choices a customer sees.
The merchant asks for a product's full description, storefront link or admin link to share or check, which the listing tool does not carry.
The merchant asks which categories one product belongs to, e.g. 'is the T-Shirt still in the summer category?'.
An agent already holds a product id -- from list_products, an order line, or the merchant -- and needs the current price or stock before reporting on it.
whenNotToUse: The merchant wants to browse, count or filter the catalogue rather than inspect one item, e.g. 'what products do I have?' or 'which products are out of stock?' -- use list_products instead.
The merchant identified the product by its SKU rather than by its id -- use get_product_by_sku, or resolve the SKU to an id with the keyword filter on list_products first.
The merchant wants to change the product's price, stock, status or details -- this tool only reads; use update_product instead.
The merchant asked about a category and its contents rather than one product -- use list_categories, or the categoryId filter on list_products.

productId.description: The id of the product to fetch, as a digits-only string. Ids come from list_products, from an order's items, or from the merchant. This is the product id, not the SKU -- a SKU like '23-TD23-32' will not resolve here.

id.description: The product id, to pass to sibling product tools.

sku.description: The merchant's stock keeping unit for the product.

description.description: The product's full storefront description. It may contain HTML and may be empty; it is the main detail this tool carries that list_products does not.

status.description: The product's own storefront state: 'sale', 'out' or 'hidden'. It can still read 'sale' for a product holding no stock, so do not report stock from this field -- read quantity instead.

quantity.description: Units currently in stock for the product as a whole: 0 means none left. Meaningless for a product with unlimited quantity, and for a product with variants the per-variant stock in skus is the number to report.

currency.description: ISO currency code of the store, e.g. 'SAR'.

sale_price.description: The discounted price while the product is on sale. An amount of 0 means no sale price is set, so quote price instead.

currency.description: ISO currency code of the store.

urls.description: Where the product lives, for the merchant to open or share.

customer.description: The public storefront URL customers see.

admin.description: The Salla dashboard URL for editing the product.

categories.description: The categories this product is filed under. Empty when the merchant has filed it nowhere.

id.description: The category id, as used by list_categories.

options.description: The choices a customer picks on the product page, e.g. Color or Size. Empty for a product sold in one form only.

values.description: The selectable values for this option.

is_out_of_stock.description: True when this value can no longer be selected because it has sold out.

skus.description: The purchasable variants, one per combination of option values. This is where per-variant price and stock live, and the field to read when the merchant asks which size or colour is left.

sku.description: The variant's own stock keeping unit.

stock_quantity.description: Units of this specific variant in stock: 0 means this variant has sold out even when other variants have not.

unlimited_quantity.description: True when this variant does not track stock, which makes stock_quantity meaningless for it.

price.description: The variant's own price, which may differ from the product's.

currency.description: ISO currency code of the store.

components._comment: 0 means no sale price is set, which the response schema spells out.
quantity, not status: a product holding no stock can still read 'sale'.
Per-variant stock: this is the number to quote when one size has sold out.

http.summary: Product Details -- return the details of one specific product by passing the product id as a path parameter.

path.name: product
path.description: Unique identification number assigned to a product.

statuses.meaning: The store's access token is missing, expired, or does not carry the products.read scope, so this product cannot be read until the app's authorization is fixed.

No product with this id exists in the store -- the id is wrong, belongs to another store, or the product has been deleted. Confirm the id with list_products before telling the merchant the product is gone.

rules.message: productId must be a numeric product id as returned by list_products, not a SKU or a product name

dependencies.reason: this tool requires a product id, and list_products is where the agent finds it when the merchant names a product rather than an id
